create-project.once_issued_fields: lead_token and console_token: private response to KeyStore only; omitted from this fixture
create-project.publish_descriptor_only_after: both recipient keys persisted and validated, full CM2 readiness passed

adopt-enrolled.effect: validate the exact existing private Console record and native roster; no issuance or roster edit
adopt-enrolled.manager_setup_rule: existing full-roster changes stay explicit owner setup; no automatic replacement or hidden scope widening
adopt-enrolled.roster_consistency: capture exact selected roster revision and entry; fresh same-member profile/roster before publication must agree; changed roster refuses with cortex_provisioning_conflict; no roster write or clobber

reissue-project-keys.effect: explicit recovery only, with original project creation operation id and fresh idempotency key
reissue-project-keys.warning: both lead and Console credentials rotate; neither original token remains usable after committed issuance

prepare-mac-access.effect: explicit manager-authorized verified private executable staging and dedicated keychain ACL preparation only
prepare-mac-access.result: PREPARED, never KOS READY or publication
prepare-mac-access.promotion: if executable identity changes, fresh explicit manager qualification and a headless final read precede service publication; failure preserves prior runtime and unit

owner_authority_probe: GET /v1/auth/privileged-actions?limit=1; same verified installation; bounded, discard audit body
plaintext_replay: never exists; same-key replay returns receipt only
